queries: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND v.points_won IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points_won, avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM country_averages) AS difference_from_country_average FROM country_averages ORDER BY death_country

WITH country_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS average_points_won FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, average_points_won, average_points_won - AVG(average_points_won) OVER () AS difference_from_country_average FROM country_averages;

assumptions.assumption: Each award-vote row contributes equally to its death country's average; players with unknown death country are excluded.

responses.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS average_points_won FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, average_points_won, average_points_won - AVG(average_points_won) OVER () AS difference_from_country_average FROM country_averages;

assumptions.assumption: Each award-vote record contributes separately to its country's average; NULL points are ignored by AVG, and NULL death countries are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: Give each player equal weight by averaging their award-vote points first, then averaging those player averages by death country.
alternatives.sql: WITH player_averages AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS average_points_won FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.player_id, p.death_country), country_averages AS (SELECT death_country, AVG(average_points_won) AS average_points_won FROM player_averages GROUP BY death_country) SELECT death_country, average_points_won, average_points_won - AVG(average_points_won) OVER () AS difference_from_country_average FROM country_averages;

assumptions.assumption: Players with a missing death country are excluded because they cannot be assigned to a country.

alternatives.interpretation: Include missing death country as its own group in the per-country average and overall average.
